title: Hands-Off Loop Monitor
objective: Implement one read-only loop monitor with interactive terminal rendering, non-interactive JSONL output, reconnect cursors, and stale-heartbeat detection.
constraints: Monitoring is read-only against the run directory.
Interactive and non-interactive output use the same Python monitor authority.
A cursor file may be written only outside the run directory when explicitly requested.
Do not add task, control, scheduler, queue, journal, checkpoint, or TUI authority.
Do not persist private model chain-of-thought.
acceptance: Monitor auto-detects TTY mode and supports explicit interactive/noninteractive overrides.
JSON and JSONL output conform to the loop monitor snapshot contract.
Reconnect cursors and stale-heartbeat detection are deterministic.
Bash and PowerShell leafctl surfaces reach the same monitor implementation.
Focused tests pass without requiring a live provider or worker.

contracts: Bash and PowerShell monitor help routes passed
active monitor JSON snapshot returned blocked state, cursor 39, and exit code 2
